generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the climber base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the climber program gave as defaults until then.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Watson and Dallwitz's description of the family: the leaves are alternate, the lower ones sometimes opposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Watson and Dallwitz's description of the family: the leaves are usually distichous, in two ranks, otherwise spiral.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 202 Vitaceae: mostly shrubs climbing by tendrils, or small trees; leaves alternate (the lower ones sometimes opposite), simple or compound; flowers bisexual or of separate sexes on the same plant; fruit a berry, often juicy.

traits.sexual_system.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 202 Vitaceae: mostly shrubs climbing by tendrils, or small trees; leaves alternate (the lower ones sometimes opposite), simple or compound; flowers bisexual or of separate sexes on the same plant; fruit a berry, often juicy.

traits.fruit_type.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 202 Vitaceae: mostly shrubs climbing by tendrils, or small trees; leaves alternate (the lower ones sometimes opposite), simple or compound; flowers bisexual or of separate sexes on the same plant; fruit a berry, often juicy.

traits.leaf_division.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 301, 304, family Vitaceae: leaf division simple or compound (palmate, pinnate); read as {"compound": "often", "simple": "often"}.

traits.leaf_venation.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 301, 304, family Vitaceae: leaf venation palmate (simple leaves), often; read as {"palmate": "often"}.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 301, 304, family Vitaceae: leaf incision palmately lobed (simple leaves), often; read as {"lobed": "often"}.

traits.stipules.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 301, 304, family Vitaceae: stipules true, caducous; read as true.

traits.inflorescence.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 301, 304, family Vitaceae: inflorescence cyme, corymb or panicle; read as {"corymb": "often", "cyme": "often", "panicle": "often"}.

traits.flowering_position.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 301, 304, family Vitaceae: flowering position terminal on shoots, appearing opposite leaves (rarely axillary), usually; read as {"terminal": "usually"}.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 301, 304, family Vitaceae: flower symmetry actinomorphic; read as "actinomorphic".
